issues.text: The applyTemplateVariables added at the two entry points doesn't replace the downstream call, so the same query gets interpolated 2-3 times.
issues.zh: 兩個入口補上的 applyTemplateVariables 沒有取代下游那一次，同一個 query 會被插值 2～3 次

issues.text: The two new tests mock out runQuery, which conveniently keeps the final query sent out of the assertions; the newly introduced request.filters behavior has no test coverage.
issues.zh: 兩個新測試 mock 掉 runQuery，剛好把「最終送出的 query」擋在斷言之外；新引入的 request.filters 行為沒有測試

issues.text: toHaveBeenCalledTimes(5) doesn't explain how the number 5 was derived.
issues.zh: toHaveBeenCalledTimes(5) 沒有說明 5 是怎麼算出來的

issues.text: The two entry points now run the same three-step pipeline, but their filter order is reversed.
issues.zh: 兩個入口現在跑同一組三步驟 pipeline，filter 順序卻是相反的

open_questions.text: The two new tests mock templateSrv.replace to substitute $__auto with 5m and assert expr === 'count_over_time({a="b"}[5m])'. Does the real applyTemplateVariables actually substitute $__auto in production?
open_questions.zh: 兩個新測試把 templateSrv.replace mock 成會把 $__auto 換成 5m，並據此斷言 expr === 'count_over_time({a="b"}[5m])'。真實的 applyTemplateVariables 在正式環境也會把 $__auto 換掉嗎？

open_questions.text: The split request now carries interpolated targets into trackGroupedQueries, where legendFormat is reported without obfuscation — does analytics expect the pre- or post-interpolation value?
open_questions.zh: 分割後的 request 現在帶著插值過的 targets 進入 trackGroupedQueries，其中 legendFormat 是未經 obfuscate 就上報的欄位——analytics 這邊預期收到的是插值前還是插值後的值？
